'''Wishies''' are a star-shaped currency used to buy items and upgrades from the [[Wishy Well]].

== Earning ==

Wishies are earned in the following ways:

# '''Completing [[Daily Wishies|daily goals]]''' – which are randomized, for up to 35 wishies. The three tasks have set wishy values. One is 5 wishies, another is 10 wishies, and the last is 20 wishies.
#'''Earning [[badges]]''' – all badges together are worth 3415 wishies total, but you can only earn each badge one time.
# '''Completing [[Tinstle Tasks]].'''
#'''Winning [[Dance Barn|dance tournaments]]''' – for up to 70 wishies. The first tier earns 20 wishies, and the second tier earns 50 wishies. (The last tier earns the daily reward but no wishies.)
Additionally, some level 10 Wildlands tasks can yield wishies. After fully upgrading the [[Wildlands]] to level 10, it cannot be upgraded further, but the task board will still offer random tasks with random rewards. Sometimes the reward is set to 20 wishies.

== Uses ==

Wishies are used to purchase upgrades and items at the [[Wishy Well]]. Upgrades include [[Crafting|recipes]], improvements to the [[Badgetown]] stores and [[reconstitooter]], and improvements to your character, like more energy or faster movement.

''Tip:'' Because the easiest source of wishies are badges, you may have difficulty buying all upgrades later in the game if you spend too many wishies on items early on. You may want to save your wishies for the most useful upgrades instead.
